```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
param_df <-read.csv("Tables/PB_tabs/PB_param_tab.csv")

library(flextable)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Select and rename columns (same selection as your kbl() call)
ft_df <- param_df |>
  select(param, species, year, q2.5, q25, q50, q75, q97.5) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, digits = 2)))
ft_df$year <- as.integer(ft_df$year)

names(ft_df) <- c("Parameters", "species", "year",
                   "2.5%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "97.5%")
ft_df <- ft_df |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, digits = 2)))
names(ft_df) <- c("Parameters", "species", "year",
                   "2.5%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "97.5%")
```

## R Markdown


```{r }
## complie table ----
# 2. Build the flextable
ft <- flextable(ft_df) %>%
  colformat_double(j = c("2.5%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "97.5%"), digits = 2) %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  merge_v(j = c("Parameters", "species", "year")) %>%   # collapse_rows equivalent
  add_header_row(values = c("", "Quantiles"), colwidths = c(3, 5)) %>%  # add_header_above equivalent
  align(align = "center", part = "header") %>%
  set_caption(caption = "Parameter CrIs") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  fix_border_issues() %>%
  autofit()

ft
```


# Density
```{r}
## read/prepare data ----
ci_df <- read.csv("Tables/PB_tabs/PB_density.csv", check.names = FALSE)
# check.names = FALSE keeps the "1990", "1991" etc. column names intact

## replace (NA, NA) with (0, 0) ----
ci_df <- ci_df |>
  mutate(across(`1990`:`2016`, ~ ifelse(.x == "(NA, NA)", "(0, 0)", .x)))

## build flextable ----
ft2 <- flextable(ci_df) |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  merge_v(j = c("species")) |>                # collapse repeated species labels
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", "", "Year"),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 5)                     # species, trt, then 5 year columns
  ) |>
  align(align = "center", part = "header") |>
  set_header_labels(species = "Species", trt = "Treatment") |>
  set_caption(caption = "Credible intervals by species, treatment, and year") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  fix_border_issues() |>
  autofit()
ft2
```

  ) |>

ft3
